purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The West Coast New Area government says anyone may use the official apps, Qingdao Online Real Estate, or the registry-center account to query natural conditions and cadastral-map information by registered property address, certificate number, or unit number; rights-holder authorization is required for expanded details. Qingdao Online Real Estate links a “public cadastral map query”. This is a property-identifier query flow, not a coordinate-based parcel feature API. No owner/address or registration details were queried.
registryAssessment: Official local registry service is confirmed for Qingdao West Coast New Area/Huangdao. The public-map entry is visible, but the WUP coordinate cannot be resolved from the published instructions without a property identifier; no open parcel geometry coverage is claimed.
